title: Rav Zutra son of Rav Zeira
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites [Shabbat 157a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.157a.12) for the Rabbis attending to the son of Rav Zutra son of Rav Zeira and releasing his vows. He notes that [Nedarim 77a](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.77a.5) reads “son of Rav Ze’ira.”[^1]

notes.text: In the consulted Shabbat, the Rabbis attend to Rav Zutra himself, son of Rav Zeira. The consulted Nedarim has the extra generation: they attend to the son of Rav Zutra son of Rav Ze’ira.
